model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates a distribution across three distinct years, represented by a total of three slices. The largest segment, colored blue and labeled "2019" just outside the perimeter, accounts for 46.0% of the total, with the absolute value "(46)" displayed directly beneath the percentage inside the slice. Proceeding counter-clockwise, the next largest segment is colored orange, labeled "2018", and represents 33.0% with an absolute value of "(33)". The smallest segment is green, labeled "2017", and makes up 21.0% with an absolute value of "(21)". The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, category labels are positioned adjacent to their respective slices, while both percentage labels and corresponding numerical values in parentheses are located inside the segments. None of the slices are visually emphasized through explosion or offset. Visually, the segments are arranged in descending order of size in a counter-clockwise direction starting from the top.
